# Council of AI source catalogue — sovereign.wiki

> Research software references and routes to published AI-behaviour measurements, methods, signed evidence and free verification.

## Identity
Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence. Operated by CSOAI Ltd, UK company 16939677.
This site is a static source catalogue. It does not execute tasks or process payments.

## Interpretation
Use live evidence for current counts and coverage. Read the selected endpoint's current response for availability and payment terms.
Measurement applies to its named system, method, inputs and observation period. A signature verifies origin and integrity; it does not establish regulatory compliance or safety.
A catalogue reference does not establish ownership, endorsement, a completed integration or a security review. Check upstream provenance and licences before reuse.
